rules.name: Acetoacetic ester synthesis — C2 monoalkylation demo

source.book: Strategic Applications of Named Reactions in Organic Synthesis

rules.structure_evidence: PDF page 56 rendered scheme and explanatory text; alkylating agent is represented generically as R2-X, instantiated here with bromoethane for a deterministic replay.

reported_scope: C2 alkylation of acetoacetic esters with primary or secondary alkyl, allyl, or benzyl electrophiles
exclusions: This record does not encode the subsequent hydrolysis/decarboxylation step

limitations: The book scheme uses a generic R2-X drawing; the bromoethane instance is constructed for replay and is not claimed as a reported substrate example.
Leaving-group atom map 10 is intentionally deleted from the product; strict SMIRKS audit remains pending.
